result.instructions: Tools for Cronitor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my scheduled jobs are failing right now?"; "List all my monitors and when each last checked in."; "Show details for my nightly backup monitor.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cronitor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cronitor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cronitor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cronitor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cronitor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cronitor_list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List monitors and their current passing/failing status. Cronitor API: GET /monitors (paginated via page + pageSize).

tools.name: cronitor_get_monitor
tools.title: Get monitor
tools.description: Get full detail for one monitor (latest_event, latest_invocations, passing status) — the 'is X healthy right now?' tool. Cronitor API: GET /monitors/{key}.

tools.name: cronitor_create_monitor
tools.title: Create monitor
tools.description: Creates a monitor in Cronitor (additive). Cronitor API: POST /monitors. Sends only the fields you provide.

type.description: Monitor type: job | check | heartbeat | site.

schedule.description: Cron expression (job) or interval string, e.g. '0 9 * * *' or 'every 5 minutes'.

note.description: Free-form note stored on the monitor.

tools.name: cronitor_update_monitor
tools.title: Update monitor
tools.description: Creates or updates a monitor by key (e.g. change schedule, pause via paused:true). Cronitor API: PUT /monitors with a single monitor object. Sends only the fields you provide.

key.description: Monitor key/id to create or update.

type.description: Monitor type: job | check | heartbeat | site.

schedule.description: Cron expression (job) or interval string, e.g. '0 9 * * *' or 'every 5 minutes'.

note.description: Free-form note stored on the monitor.

paused.description: Set true to pause the monitor, false to resume.

tools.name: cronitor_delete_monitor
tools.title: Delete monitor
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes a monitor from Cronitor. Destructive and irreversible. Cronitor API: DELETE /monitors/{key}.

tools.name: cronitor_ping_monitor
tools.title: Ping monitor (telemetry)
tools.description: Reports a telemetry event (run/complete/fail/ok/pause) for a monitor — records job/heartbeat activity and can clear or trigger alerts. Cronitor telemetry: GET {telemetryUrl}/p/{apiKey}/{monitorKey}?state=...

state.description: Telemetry state: run | complete | fail | ok | pause.

message.description: Optional message attached to the event.

series.description: Optional series id to correlate run/complete pings.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cronitor
prompts.description: What you can do with Cronitor here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_which_monitors_are_failing_right_now
prompts.title: Find which monitors are failing right now
prompts.description: The AI lists your monitors with their passing or failing status and summarizes the failing ones, so you see what needs attention first.

prompts.name: check_if_one_job_is_healthy
prompts.title: Check if one job is healthy
prompts.description: The AI opens a monitor and reads its latest event, latest invocations and passing status, then tells you in plain words if the job is healthy.

prompts.name: pause_a_monitor_or_change_its_schedule
prompts.title: Pause a monitor or change its schedule
prompts.description: The AI updates a monitor by key, for example to pause it with paused:true or to change the schedule. It sends only the fields you give.

prompts.name: create_a_new_monitor_for_a_scheduled_job
prompts.title: Create a new monitor for a scheduled job
prompts.description: The AI creates a monitor in Cronitor with the fields you provide, so a new job is watched from its first run.

prompts.name: send_a_run_complete_or_fail_ping_for_a_monitor
prompts.title: Send a run, complete or fail ping for a monitor
prompts.description: The AI reports a telemetry event (run, complete, fail, ok or pause) for a monitor. This records job activity and can clear or trigger alerts.
